source_text: Immediate health risks include severe pain, hemorrhage, shock from blood loss, urinary retention, wound infection, sepsis, tetanus, and transmission of bloodborne diseases like HIV due to shared unsterilized instruments; long-term consequences encompass chronic urinary tract infections, vaginal and pelvic infections, menstrual difficulties, keloid scar formation, female genital tract damage leading to infertility or dyspareunia, sexual dysfunction with reduced lubrication and heightened pain during intercourse, and psychological trauma manifesting as depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder. [10] [11]
